name: What compensation can I seek after an injury on private property?

mainEntity.name: What compensation can I seek after an injury on private property?

acceptedAnswer.text: After an injury on private property, you may be able to seek compensation for various damages. These can include medical expenses (past and future), lost wages due to inability to work, pain and suffering, emotional distress, and property damage. In some cases, if the property owner's conduct was particularly egregious, punitive damages might also be awarded, though these are less common. The specific types and amounts of compensation available depend on the severity of your injuries, the impact on your life, and the specifics of California law.
